games.name: A Tower Full of Cats
games.summary:
A Tower Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to gather cats through the whole history of catkind... and beyond!

Travel across beautifully illustrated levels representing different eras and worlds, each overflowing with adorable felines hiding in plain sight. Discover over 1,400 cats, uncover special items, and reveal charming surprises as you ascend the mysterious Tower.

Whether you're a completionist, a cat lover, or simply looking for a relaxing and rewarding experience, A Tower Full of Cats delivers a playful journey that keeps you smiling at every floor.

games.name: ANOMALITH
games.summary:
Remain yourself. Live on.

Anomalies × Mutating Girl × Survival TPS

Survive a world crawling with Anomalies.
The girl faces her fate, gun in hand—

ーーーーー
■ STORY
ーーーーー
Japan, the year 20██.
Anomaly Zones suddenly appear without any sign.
In search of her friend who went missing in an Anomaly Zone, 17 year old Reona Minazuki becomes a Diver for the government-backed Anomaly Zone Countermeasures Office.

On her first Dive, as countless other Divers fall victim to the Zone, a strange power awakens within her.

The sole survivor, she heads deep into the abyss of Anomaly Zones.

Her friend's disappearance, the origin of Anomaly Zones, and the mystery of her powers—
When all of it is finally revealed, what will she see—?

games.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
games.summary:
Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fighter rooted in the spirit of elemental mastery. Designed for both newcomers and veterans, it channels the energy of classic fighting games while breaking new ground in movement, style, and combat expression. Built with a focus on fluidity, responsiveness, and online integrity, the game invites players to discover what it truly means to fight with purpose.

Hand-drawn in 2D, it is crafted to preserve the style and expressive animation of the original series.

games.name: Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition
games.summary:
Build, manage, and expand the city of your dreams in Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition, the award-winning city-building game optimized for Nintendo Switch™ 2 with 10 included DLC expansions and content packs.

Start with a few roads and grow your city into a bustling metropolitan hub. Plan neighborhoods, manage public services, shape civic policies, and respond to the ever-changing needs of thousands of citizens. Whether you create a quiet coastal town, a busy industrial center, or a sprawling modern metropolis, your city is yours to design.

Optimized and Expanded for Nintendo Switch 2

Experience Cities: Skylines with upgrades designed for large-scale city building on Nintendo Switch™ 2, including improved visuals, better performance, expanded building tools, and new ways to play.
• 25 Buildable Tiles: Expand your city across a much larger area, increased from the original 9-tile limit.
• Map Editor: Create and customize your own landscapes and maps before you start building.
• UX Improvements: Use precision placement, a distance indicator, and updated snapping options for more refined construction.
• Environmental Controls Panel: Adjust atmospheric elements in real time, including time of day, rain, fog, and environmental coloring.
• Quick Selection Tool: Swap quickly between essential tools and assets for smoother city management.
• Graphics Options: Choose between a Performance Option targeting 60 FPS with upscaling and adjusted quality settings, or a Quality Option targeting 30 FPS and prioritizing visual fidelity.
• Keyboard and Mouse Support: Build with keyboard and mouse input alongside traditional controller configurations.

games.name: Frog Sqwad
games.summary: Up to 8 player co-op extraction puzzle-platformer where you swing, jump, catapult your friends, and eat eat EAT until you grow into a humongous Megafrog. Squad up with your frog friends and storm the Sewers for the glory of the Swamp King!

games.name: Rogue Reigns
games.summary: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

games.name: SNO: Ultimate Freeriding
games.summary:
SNO is a game about downhill skiing where you carve your way down various mountainscapes trying to score as many points as possible by pulling off high risk maneuvers and tricks.

Go for the high score or simply flow through serene, arctic landscapes. The controls are easy to learn, and there are endless procedural mountains to explore.

games.name: SULFUR
games.summary:
Descend the depths of Sulfur in this action-adventure, combining first person shooter mechanics with role-playing elements. Make important choices to survive battles and explore a world of intense and brutal combat. 수

Plan ahead, outsmart enemies and progress a world of dark creatures and cunning evil. Utilize playful and tactile weaponry in visceral and intense combat. Create unique builds by combining weapons, gear, tools, and enchantments to suit your playstyle.Whether you’re a gun-blazing risk-taker or a careful strategist, the choice is yours. 

Adapt your approach, experiment, and survive the dangers of Sulfur.

games.name: The Seance of Blake Manor
games.summary:
It is October 29th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman.

What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world - waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead.

Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together.

Navigate Blake Manor's haunted corridors and uncover its secrets as you race against time to save Miss Deane.

games.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2
games.summary:
The Digital Standard Edition features the following:

    Base game
    Two Kimetsu Academy Character Unlock Keys – Kyojuro Rengoku and Tengen Uzui
    Pre-order bonus: 2 Character Unlock Keys** – Muichiro Tokito and Mitsuri Kanroji

games.name: Glow Box
games.summary: A 60-minute adventure where all you do is glow.

games.name: Hello Kitty Party Land
games.summary: Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games. Meet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate. Jump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Try Board Game mode, and keep the fun going with quick mini games while you wait for your turn.  Create a character that’s uniquely yours! Customize everything from hairstyles to outfits, and unlock even more items as you progress through the game.

games.name: Joe & Mac Retro Collection
games.summary:
Developed by Red Art Studios, Red Art Games' internal development studio, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a compilation of Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja, Congo's Caper, and Joe & Mac 2: Lost in the Tropics, the three Joe & Mac titles developed by Data East and released on Super Nintendo between 1991 and 1995. 

In addition to allowing players to rediscover the original games as they were presented back in the 90s, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection also features numerous quality of life improvements!

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

games.name: Pokemon Legends: Z-A Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension
games.summary:
Purchase the physical version of the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Mega Dimension bundle and you will get an insert containing a code for 100 Ultra Balls as a purchase bonus. You can receive them by choosing Get via Internet in the Mystery Gift* function of your game. 

Live the life of a Pokémon Trainer and help protect the peace in Lumiose City—enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system!

Lumiose City—a home for people and Pokémon alike. Thanks to an urban redevelopment plan driven by Quasartico Inc., the lush greenery of verdant parks intermingles with facilities using the latest cutting-edge technology. A lot has changed here since the days of the Pokémon™ X and Pokémon Y games!

Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z, and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place.

And with performance upgrades for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system, you’ll experience Lumiose City like never before: with enhanced resolution and frame rates!

games.name: Souls of Bombarika
games.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
games.summary:
Solve the impossible. Expose the truth. Uncover the secrets of The Penrose Hotel in this atmospheric first person puzzle thriller.

Welcome to The Penrose. Service is impeccable and the rooms are immaculate. You’re its most valued guest, but you can’t remember checking in.

The Spectrum Retreat: Redux is a first-person puzzle thriller created by Dan Smith, Winner of the 2016 BAFTA Young Game Designer Award.

You are Alex. You awaken inside The Penrose, an unsettling art-deco hotel cut off from the outside world. Its corridors are quiet, its staff endlessly attentive, and each day follows a familiar routine. Guided by the voice of a mysterious stranger, you begin searching for the truth about why you are here.

Your escape hinges on solving The Spectrum Retreat’s series of intricate logic and spatial challenges. Absorb and swap colors to slip through security barriers, redirect energy, manipulate your surroundings and rethink the rules of each space. But every puzzle solved brings you closer to something The Penrose would rather keep hidden.

Beneath the hotel’s facade lies a story of memory and grief. You’ll need to decide whether some realities are better left undisturbed.

The Spectrum Retreat: Redux rebuilds the award-winning original for Nintendo Switch™ 2, with:
- Entirely rebuilt lighting and reflections
- Increased fidelity with HDR support
- Nintendo Switch 2™ features: HD Rumble 2 and mouse controls

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary:
Welcome to Titanium Court! Table for one? You have a reservation I assume? You don’t!? Ah, I see. Just minding your own business before stumbling into a realm of magic and faeries, were you? Not to worry, happens all the time. Tell you what, why don’t I see if we can squeeze you in somewhere while you become acquainted with the many amenities offered by the Court.

Amenities such as:

Puzzling Battles: For tonight's entertainment, the Court is at WAR! Just a little something to pass the time, you see. Who's in command? Why do you ask? Are you volunteering? Oh don't worry, you won't be issuing orders to these faerie troops. They wouldn't follow them anyways. I think you'll have more success commanding the terrain itself to fall in your favor, haha.

Puzzling Narrative: Lore dumps are strictly against my religion I'm afraid, so you'll have to uncover the secrets of the Court yourself. Some of them may even fundamentally change you as a person. Be careful with those!

Diverse and fulfilling career options: Warlord, Arsonist, Celebrity, Insurance Fraudster. Your time within the Court will qualify you for many of these exalted and lucrative positions.

games.name: Look Outside
games.summary:
Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters - human and otherwise. 

Survival Horror & Resource Management
Plan tense expeditions outside your apartment as you fend off grotesque monsters dwelling in and around your building. Return to your home with gathered resources and partial answers to your questions to recuperate by playing games, making dinner, crafting tools, and getting to know your neighbors turned allies. 

Inventive Turn-Based Combat
Clash with over 150 hand-crafted creatures in turn-based combat that accounts for space between you and your foes as you wield makeshift weapons and items you've gathered in the corridors of the building. 

Impeccable Body Horror Aesthetic
Meet your macabre fate in a bizarre world teeming with an unconventional and occasionally psychotic cast of characters - some of which you can recruit and offer safe harbor in your apartment as the mystery unravels. 

Small, Experimental, and Unwaveringly Weird
Offering 10 - 12 hours of playtime with a dozen boss encounters, friends to recruit, and visitors to invite back to your home, Look Outside offers different experiences for every player on their way to uncover several different endings.

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.summary:
Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. 

Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. 

Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle. 

Features:

Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets

Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic 

Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more

Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further!

Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration

50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade

Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats

20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat

Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeat

games.name: James Pond Legacy: The Pond is Not Enough
games.summary:
The James Pond series of games is one of the most beloved and successful franchises from the 80’s & 90’s. Known for its innovative gameplay, memorable graphics, atmospheric music and blockbusting reviews, the series captivated gamers the world over and set a new standard for platform games.

This collection brings together the entire James Pond series of C64 versions along with Amiga 500, Sega Megadrive/Genesis and SNES, where available, for the first time... James Pond: Underwater Agent, James Pond: Codename RoboCod, James Pond 3: Operation StarFish and James Pond: Aquatic Games!

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

games.name: Let's Sing 2027
games.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

games.name: Let's Sing ABBA
games.summary: Celebrate the glorious comeback of the Swedish pop giant ABBA. Party solo or with your friends to some of your favourite classics from the band's repertoire! Choose from a collection of 31 ABBA classics and perform them in seven different game modes. After a 40-year break, ABBA is back! So why not perform some of the band's biggest hits in your own living room to celebrate their triumphant return to the stage. Travel back to the glory days with hits like “Gimme! Gimme! Gimme!” and “Waterloo”. Get some friends together to party with “Dancing Queen”, the musical number “Mamma Mia” or rock out to “I Still Have Faith In You”, the lead track from their brand new album.

games.name: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut
games.summary:
Brilliant, burnt-out, possibly cursed – you play as operant Hershel Wilk, alias CASCADE. Five years ago you led your team into the abyss and have been haunted by your failures ever since. Now you've been recalled for a mysterious assignment that may give you a chance to prove yourself again.

Find yourself thrown into a three-way struggle for cultural and ideological power, played out across an unforgettable new city. In ZERO PARADES, the world itself is a character with its own secrets, traumas, and miracles for you to discover.

To get anywhere in this world, you'll need friends. Unfortunately, you don't have any. Instead, you'll go up against international bankers, foreign techno-fascists, psychic doppelgängers, a paranoid TV presenter, a man with a box for a heart, and dozens more. Everyone you meet has their own agendas, beliefs, and secrets for you to uncover and turn to your own ends.

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: CRYMELIGHT
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
games.summary:
The critically-acclaimed, story-driven Marvel adventure, now optimized for Nintendo Switch 2.

Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

The Encore Edition is exclusive to Switch 2 and includes a new set of outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Dressed in 1980s glam rock threads, the Guardians are ready to bring down the house. Literally.

games.name: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition
games.summary:
The future of humanity is balanced on the edge of a blade. Ravaged by strange, powerful creatures, Earth has been abandoned, and what is left of the decimated human race has fled to a Colony in outer space.

After travelling from the Colony, EVE arrives on the desolate remains of our planet with a clear-cut mission: to save humankind by reclaiming Earth from the Naytiba - the malevolent force that has devastated it.

But as EVE tackles the Naytiba one-by-one, piecing together the mysteries of the past in the ruins of human civilization, she realizes that her mission is far from straightforward. In fact, almost nothing is as it seems...

Engage in blisteringly fast combat as you slash a path through the remnants of Earth. Unleash graceful yet brutal attacking combos, unlock new moves and weapon upgrades, and face epic boss encounters that will challenge both brain and brawn in equal measure.

Unravel a gripping human fate story, with mature themes, a thought-provoking narrative and emotionally-charged revelations from beginning to end.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: The battle for Hyrule begins. The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Enjoy completely overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, expanded dialogue, and symphonic orchestral music. You can also jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this an excellent entry point into the Legend of Zelda™ series.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: - Fast pace gaming and easy to play- Wonderful graphics- Advanced multipliers mean you get the best wins possible- Auto Hold Feature: Video Poker Classic holds the cards for you! Our finely tuned auto algorithm determines your best chances at success and automatically holds your cards. You can change that of course and take a risk at grabbing the big bucksStart playing and be entertained for hours

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.summary:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary: Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode. Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge. Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

games.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
games.summary:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Harold Halibut
games.summary:
Harold Halibut is a handmade narrative game about friendship, and life on a city-sized spaceship submerged in an alien ocean. 

It's been 250 years since your home - an ark-like spaceship - fled an Earth on the verge of cold war to find a habitable planet on which to preserve the human race. 
You are Harold, a young lab assistant for the ship's lead scientist, Jeanne Mareaux. While most of the ship's inhabitants have reconciled themselves to a life lived aboard the sunken ship, Mareaux still works tirelessly to find a way for the ship to leave the planet and find a new, dryer home. 

But of course the weird, wonderful and diverse people of the Fedora keep Harold busy too. Until one fateful encounter plunges Harold into a new world that nobody could have guessed existed - and one that may hold the key to Mareaux's re-launch plans. 

Join Harold as he explores a vibrant retro-future world, talks (with full voice acting) to its inhabitants, and occasionally goes hands on by sticking screwdrivers in things, operating complex machinery, and more in his quest to find the true meaning of 'home'.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds behind Persona 3, 4, and 5 comes Metaphor: ReFantazio, a unique fantasy world, where your protagonist will journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart. By awakening to an “Archetype,” you will unlock the power to channel and combine the abilities of unique job classes. Strengthen your bonds and build your party to take down powerful foes and discover the kingdom’s true nature.

-Go on uests, dungeon dive, & hunt for treasures by day. Strengthen relationships, build bonds, & increase virtues by night. Choose your actions wisely, time management is key to achieving your goal. 

Ride your “gauntlet runner” to faraway dungeons & towns across an expansive world. Discover beautiful landscapes  accompanied by captivating music, immersive UI, & anime cutscenes.

A unique battle system combining turn based & real time action grants strategy & exhilaration at every turn. Party customization through “Archetypes” provides freedom to personalize your adventure. 

A mysterious & exciting story unfolds in a world where people must fight their own anxiety. Join the high-stakes Royal Tournament that promises hours of captivating exploration and discovery.

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary:
Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition!

Meet Pikmin: small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with creatures multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. 

Dandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and sometimes explorers like to get in on some friendly competition.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game features Dandori Academy, an extensive series of Dandori exam stages for you to test your skill and earn in-game medals! A total of 72 stages will be released over time - and they vary in difficulty, so you can choose the ones that match your skill level.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

games.name: Supermarket Simulator
games.summary:
Run your own supermarket. Stock shelves, handle cashier tasks, process online orders, design & expand. Set the prices based on the market. 

In "Supermarket Simulator", every decision matters. Will you rise to the occasion, transforming a modest establishment into a retail powerhouse, all while balancing customer satisfaction, finances, and mafia expectations?

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary:
Ravenswatch is a top-down roguelike action game that combines intense real-time combat with deep gameplay and high replay value.

After the success of Curse of the Dead Gods, Passtech returns with a new formula and game experience that can be played solo or with up to four players in co-op.

To defeat the Nightmare and reach the final chapter, you will need a strong build, focus and excellent teamwork. Increase your fighting power in battles then face the level boss when you feel ready... or when you no longer have a choice.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
games.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in "Gothic I" and "Gothic II." Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III – every game will be different and unique – but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana. [JoWood Productions]

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: The Ascent: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. 

You play as a worker enslaved by The Ascent Group, a corporate-run metropolis stretching high into the sky and filled with creatures from all over the galaxy. You must take up arms and embark on a new mission to find out what started it all.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary: Hello! Bouncy Bernard is a cute doggy that likes fun a lot. Puzzles is one of his favorite. However, this is not only about fun. He is very smart and is fond of discovering the world as well. He invites you to accompany him in doing this. Today he wants to be with you to discover striking representations of well-known racing cars and vehicles. There are Formula 1 car, motorcycles, NASCAR racing cars, rally cars, monster trucks, snowmobiles and water scooters. So, as you can see there is huge collection of objects to became familiar with and have fun in playing puzzles along with Bouncy Bernard. Don’t wait any longer! Main features: - Interactive puzzles parts for children aged 3+. - Three levels of difficulty (6 parts, 12 parts, 20 parts puzzles). - Beautiful and realistic 3D pictures that are created to both entertain and educate children. - Intuitive navigation. - Drag and drop puzzle pieces. Tap a piece to make it large, move into the place of destination and release. - Gray, faded picture background facilitating matching pieces. - Supporting sound effects. - Switch on / off music function.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary:
Dive into a story-driven survival-horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. 

A miracle crop designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. It twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, hollowed out by a chemical addiction and driven by primal hunger. 

Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safe haven. But their journey draws the attention of the Pastor and his mysterious following. He sees remaining humans not as people, but as fertile soil for his plans.

Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution: every door can lead to salvation… or devastation.

Protect Ava at all costs. The world can die, but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a hostile wilderness that wants you gone. No one is coming to save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.summary: Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3
games.summary:
"Fighting to liveand living to fight" - A brand new RPG adventure awaits in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. Bringing together the futures of Xenoblade Chronicles and Xenoblade Chronicles 2, this title will take players to the world of Aionios, home to two hostile nations.  Keves: a nation where mechanical technology was developed. Their armies are composed of units consisting mainly of combat vehicles. They use units of small, mobile weapons operated by soldiers riding them. 

Agnus: a nation strong in ether, a magical technology. Their forces are built around units that specialise in ether combat, and they fight with small, mobile, autonomous weapons that use ether technology. 

Six soldiers hailing from these nations, will take part in a grand tale with life as its central theme. 

Noah: One of the protagonists of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 and a solider of Keves. Noah is also an "off-seer" who mourns for soldiers who've lost their lives on the battlefield. 

Lanz: An ally of Noah's who wields a great sword that doubles as a shield. 

Eunie: A childhood friend of Noah and Lanz who has a sharp tongue and rough personality. She specialises in healing her allies in battle. 

Mio: The other protagonist of this story, Mio is a soldier of Agnus and an off-seer like Noah. 

Taion: A tactician who fights alongside Mio using his smarts and insight. 

Sena: This soldier is an ally of Mio and Taion. Despite her petite figure, Sena wields immense physical strength!

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.summary:
The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality. Fulfill your duty as a Hunter by tracking and defeating powerful monsters and forging strong new weapons and armor from the materials you harvest from your hunt as you uncover the connection between the people of the Forbidden Lands and the locales they inhabit. The ultimate hunting experience awaits you in Monster Hunter Wilds.

A few years past, a young boy named Nata was rescued at the border of the Forbidden Lands, an unexplored region the guild has yet to survey.
After hearing the boy’s tale of his lone escape from a mysterious monster that attacked his village, the Guild organized an expedition into the Forbidden Lands to investigate.

A Living World

Environments within the Forbidden Lands can drastically change as the weather shifts constantly and suddenly. During the harsh Fallow and perilous Inclemency periods, ravenous monsters will venture out to hunt in packs, yet during the Plenty periods, wildlife is rich and abundant.

Monsters

The monsters who inhabit these environments have been forced to adapt to the dynamic changes that occur, using their unique characteristics to survive and thrive.

Hunting

As the world around them changes, so must the hunters and their tactics. Not only will hunters have a multitude of weapons and armor to choose from, but the art of the hunt itself has evolved as hunters learn to anticipate monsters’ behavior and familiarize themselves with their environment.

Characters

From hunting partners to fellow expedition members, you’ll encounter plenty of those who will support you on your journey.

games.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
games.summary: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game from independent studio Panache Digital Games and published by Private Division. From Creative Director Patrice Désilets, experience the beauty and danger of Africa 10 million years ago as your hominid clan must Explore, Expand, and Evolve to survive over the course of 8 million years. Write your own unique story of human evolution and see if you can survive like our ancestors before us.

games.name: Riders Republic
games.summary:
Jump into the Riders Republic massive multiplayer playground! Meet and compete with other players, and ride hard with an exciting range of activities such as bike, ski, snowboard, wingsuit and rocket wingsuit. Live out the rider's fantasy as you roam free in a huge, vibrant open world, always buzzing with other players around you. Immerse yourself in iconic American national parks including Bryce Canyon, Yosemite Valley, Mammoth Mountain... all mashed up for you to shred!

Squad up with your friends and compete in a wide range of multiplayer modes: feel the rush of downhill races, dominate maps in team vs team competitions, or give it your best shot in epic mass PvP races with more than 50 other players. Go all out. Join the madness!

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.summary:
Experience the story from beginning to end in the definitive culmination of the Attack on Titan game series.

Engage in pulse-pounding battles against the Nine Titans - making their first appearance in the game series - and immerse yourself in brand-new story arcs. Iconic moments from previous titles have been completely reimagined to deliver a fresh experience, with the narrative carried all the way through to its dramatic climax.

The series’ signature omni-directional mobility action has evolved to the next level, offering the most exhilarating and stylish high-speed combat in the history of the Attack on Titan game series.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary:
This game depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

The story takes place in Steam Bison, America. There, the power of highly advanced steam engines has ushered in a new world, greatly surpassing even London's technological development.

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Professor Layton and Luke begins.

games.name: Stage Tour
games.summary:
Stage Tour is a new rhythm-action game featuring 90+ officially licensed songs spanning six decades, 180+ authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, 50+ bandmates, and new ways to play.

Play your way with Lead Guitar, Groove Guitar/Bass, Drums, Vocals, PC Keyboard or gamepad, including 4-Lane and 5-Lane Arcade Mode. Choose from Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert difficulties along with Expert Plus on Drums, and take the stage with the official lineup of Stage Tour hardware.

games.name: A Game About Digging A Hole Together
games.summary: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

games.name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
games.summary:
Anima is a third-person action RPG that weaves together two fates - one of a legendary monster and a mysterious girl with no memory of her past, the other of an immortal soul cursed to wander the world forever.

Their existence will take an unexpected turn when they discover that all of them have been involved in something sinister, a war in the shadows in which they will have an involuntary leading role in opposing sides of the table.

Experience the original Anima: Gate of Memories and its companion story Anima: The Nameless Chronicles - both fully remastered with improved visuals and gameplay.

Explore a rich fantasy universe inspired by the Anima Beyond Fantasy tabletop RPG saga, filled with deep lore, fast-paced combat, and branching storylines shaped by your choices.

games.name: Baptiste
games.summary:
Devastated by a family tragedy, Sara and her son, Tom, seek a new start at Jagged Shore Cliff. However, their worst fear is waiting for them there. 

In their new and mysterious home, a dusty cabinet holds Baptiste, an unsettling doll accompanied by an ominous warning: “Never release this from its glass prison.” 

What ought to have been a shelter becomes the scene of a nightmare that defies all logic, putting their sanity and desire to survive to the test

games.name: Calame
games.summary:
In Westalia, a legend is more than a story: it is a weapon of mass destruction. When belief in a legend grows strong enough, that power can reshape the battlefield or consume those who wield it. To overthrow the tyrannical King of Light, the Rebellion must learn to harness this divine force... without becoming the very monster they are fighting.

On one side, Kenmare fights for the freedom of the people. On the other, the Panthers fight to reclaim the throne. Their alliance is a matter of survival; their visions of the future are utterly irreconcilable. And you are the one leading them.

Calame is a single-player isometric tactical RPG that combines layered, classic strategy with innovative reality-altering gameplay.

Following in the tradition of classic tactical RPGs, Calame delivers demanding, handcrafted grid-based combat where positioning, unit direction, and class synergies are the keys to survival.

games.name: Changer Seven
games.summary:
Dive into Changer Seven, an exhilarating 3D third-person action-adventure where fast-paced combat meets stunning visuals and a gripping narrative.

Lead a squad of super-powered teenagers in a tag-team/assist-based combat system to battle hordes of enemies and uncover the dark mysteries surrounding their legacy. As you fight to save humanity, you’ll also face the personal struggles that come with being a hero and the changes your choices can bring to the future.

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn - Lazarus
games.summary:
Cronos: Lazarus is a brutal new chapter to the Cronos: The New Dawn story. Step into the boots of the Warden and experience a faster, more aggressive style of combat as you fight to complete a mission the Collective must never uncover.

Return to the wastelands of New Dawn as the once-loyal Pathfinder in the process of transforming into the Warden you know and love from the base game. Isolated in the Terminal and severed from the Collective, he devotes every waking moment to awakening a lost Essence he refuses to let fade.

Your sanctuary, however, has been compromised. A new kind of hunter has been deployed with one directive: to find and eliminate you.

games.name: Demonschool
games.summary:
Demonschool is a new-style tactics RPG where motion equals action. Defeat big weirdos in between the human and demon worlds as Faye and her misfit companions, while navigating university life on a mysterious island.

Plan your team's schedule to enhance their skills and gain new abilities. Gain new teammates and enhance their relationships depending on who you choose to pursue.

games.name: Dumb Ways to Party
games.summary:
Dumb Ways to Party throws contestants into the The Dumbest of the Dumb game show - a whirlwind of wacky challenges, hilarious mishaps, surprise twists, big wins and even bigger fails!

The challenge? Out-dumb the competition and take home the prestigious title of Dumbest of the Dumb!

Are you here for glory? Fame? Or just to make a fool of yourself? Let’s find out!

games.name: Dungeons of DUSK
games.summary:
Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS.

Are you... WORTHY?

games.name: Enter the Gungeon 2
games.summary:
Enter the Gungeon 2 is a reloaded, high-caliber sequel to the iconic bullet hell dungeon crawler, reinforced with a new 3D art style, new weapons and enemies, and expanded gameplay.

Battle through areas familiar and unknown as the ruined Gungeon reveals its secrets to those brave enough to enter. Discover, unlock, and master fantastic weaponry within its procedurally generated halls and destroy the legions of Gundead pouring forth from within. Charge into dynamic battles against devilishly cute enemies, previously confined to the 2D plane, and delight as they are knocked around, tossed into the air, and thrown deep into pits.

Choose from an expanding roster of Gungeoneers full of both familiar and new faces as you rescue and extract marooned heroes from the depths of the Gungeon. Become mighty through unexpected combinations of powerful passive items, explosive active items, blessings, curses, and your own mastery over an impressive armory of weapons.

And seek to understand why you find yourself under assault in the Gungeon once again...

games.name: Hoa 2
games.summary:
Hoa 2 will transport you to a beautiful world. Explore, interact with nature, solve puzzles and seek to bring life back to a special friend.

Continuing the story from the first part, this sequel sees our little fairy return in an amazing new style. In Hoa 2, our courageous protagonist sets forth in a vibrant 3D world, interacting with nature, partnering with fascinating creatures and discovering new secrets and abilities in their quest to aid an old friend.

games.name: Homura Hime
games.summary: Homura Hime is an anime-style 3D action game merging exhilarating thrills with the tension-filled gameplay of bullet hell. Players dodge hails of projectiles, unleash combos that blend close-quarters and ranged attacks, and utilize dodges and parries to withstand the fierce onslaught of demons.

games.name: Maseylia: Echoes of the Past
games.summary:
Embark on an epic journey in Maseylia: Echoes of the Past, a 3D Metroidvania that seamlessly blends classic 2D exploration with modern 3D mechanics.

Traverse a vast techno-organic labyrinth, uncover hidden pathways, and master powerful abilities to forge your own path.

You have what it takes to escape the labyrinth? Explore, adapt, and survive.

games.name: Meat Grinder: Hotdog Simulator
games.summary: Run your own hot dog shop in the foggy town of Grimshore. Cook and serve by day, solve your meat shortage by night, and try not to ask too many questions. How far will you go to keep the grill running?

games.name: Order Up!!
games.summary: Aspiring chefs, get ready to sharpen your knives and put your short order skills to the test in Order Up.

games.name: Pastry Panic
games.summary:
Pastry Panic! is a co-op dessert factory cooking game. Up to four adorable bunnies team up to mix batter, bake cakes, chop fruit, shave ice, operate machinery... and whatever else the recipes call for!

Hop to it and juggle tasks in a chaotic kitchen, scamper to meet your daily quotas in time and coordinate your team’s efforts to achieve pastry perfection.

Just try to avoid slip-ups, and watch the clock - no bunny likes working overtime!

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary:
Beat the buzzer with this addicting finger flicking basketball game! Challenge your friends to beat your high score. Take free throws up close or drain a basket from half court.

Realistic physics keep the game easy to play but challenging to master!

Future Features:

Global Scoreboards
Additional Game Modes
Realistic Sound Effects
Motion Capture Shooting

Please send suggestions to:  fastshotbasketball@theappgallery.com

games.name: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
games.summary: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

games.name: Seina: A Tale of Spirits
games.summary:
Seina, Mika’s beloved cat, has mysteriously disappeared. Determined to find her, Mika sets out on a heartfelt adventure that leads her into a beautiful, overgrown world a place covered in moss, plants, and memories of another time.

Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a single-player fantasy adventure inspired by Japanese aesthetics and a cute, heartwarming atmosphere. As Mika, you’ll explore a magical realm filled with nature, gentle spirits, and curious creatures that seem to know more about your cat’s disappearance than they first reveal.

As you wander through ancient ruins, misty forests, and peaceful lakes, you’ll meet adorable spirit animals who will ask for your help with small quests. Some may guide you, others may need your kindness but each encounter brings you closer to discovering why Seina left, and what connects you to this forgotten world.

games.name: STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions
games.summary:
STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. 

Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet- wide objectives across a multitude of star systems using cutting edge technology.

Players will have an advanced set of tools at their disposal to tackle expeditions while they face off with the unknown perils of space- - fascinating creatures, hazardous flora, and mysterious forces that await them.

games.name: Tails of Fate
games.summary:
Long ago, on the outskirts of Fauna, where many furry creatures lived in harmony, the rings of conflict echoed as a bizarre sequence of events unfolded from the dark. The plot revolves around Reynard, Varken and Koal as they journey to save Fauna from its perishing fate. Make new friends, battle epic foes, and overcome hurdles in your path as you seek the truth with heroic warriors by your side.

Join fellow adventurers at the Tavern of Ursidae to trade gossip, look for new quests, or just celebrate your victories. Utilize it as the hub for your adventures in this beautiful, expansive world, which is full of mysterious ruins, dark dungeons, majestic castles, and eerie ancient woodlands.

games.name: Tamer Town
games.summary:
Collect Mokiton and manage a unique city as tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve, and bond together. Tamer Town is a unique blend of monster collecting and city-building gameplay, inviting you to shape an ecosystem where monsters and humans grow, thrive, and stand together in competition.

Raise over 130 unique Mokiton, each with distinct personalities, elemental traits and evolution paths. Support strong bonds between tamers and their Mokiton - it’s the foundation of a thriving city.

Generate valuable resources, sell goods and invest profits to grow your city. Assign Mokiton to jobs that match their strengths to optimize each building's output. Earn money to unlock new homes, decorations and territories. Shape your city into a thriving hub.

games.name: The 7th Guest Remake
games.summary: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

games.name: The Duskbloods
games.summary: The moontears will flow for one and one alone. Become a Bloodsworn of Dusk—a supernatural being imbued with special abilities by the power of blood—and leap into online* battles of up to eight players. The Bloodsworn have been summoned to do battle at the Dusk of Humanity. Form transient alliances and bitter rivalries alike as you take on enemies and compete for the right to First Blood.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II
games.summary:
The galaxy is in peril. Entire worlds are falling. The Imperium needs you.

Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor's warriors. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes.

Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

Heed the call of battle.

For there is only war.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.summary:
Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players!

Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside city of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...
